X_SCT_S1E01_S01_VIS.text: Open intimately. Coffee, drapes, footsteps and pauses matter. Do not rush toward the theme; let the audience want this life before it is threatened.

X_SCT_S1E01_S02_VIS.text: Make the pattern-world seductive before it becomes oppressive. Alex is not cold; he is exhilarated by a real strength he will later misuse.

X_SCT_S1E02_S01_VIS.text: Use repeated commuter pathways and practical city sounds. The Hey/Ho pulse is resilience and avoidance at the same time.

X_SCT_S1E02_S02_VIS.text: Keep the conflict small and recognizable. No villain behavior. End on Mira saying, in effect, that not everything she tells him is a problem statement.

X_SCT_S1E03_S01_VIS.text: Begin as a sincere confession. The dramatic turn occurs when praise becomes comparison and Mira realizes Alex needs her to perform a stabilizing role.

X_SCT_S1E03_S02_VIS.text: The breakup should not be explosive. Alex's urge to formulate the correct explanation is itself the final trigger. End with the Sun Comes Through motif distant and unresolved.

X_SCT_S1E04_S01_VIS.text: Do not literalize a ghost. The city simply keeps presenting habits, angles and objects that his body expects to contain Mira.

X_SCT_S1E04_S02_VIS.text: Reveal the ego wound without mocking the dream. Alex understands that the relationship had been carrying his fear of an unrealized life.

X_SCT_S1E05_S01_VIS.text: This is Mira's independent dream, not a lesson staged for Alex. Let participants hesitate, fail, laugh and find form without becoming uniform.

X_SCT_S1E05_S02_VIS.text: Play care and boundary at the same time. They part with tenderness rather than reconciliation.

X_SCT_S1E06_S01_VIS.text: Show small independent growth on both sides. The important Alex beat is choosing not to send a message whose real purpose is reassurance.

X_SCT_S1E06_S02_VIS.text: Allow 'what was the point?' to remain unanswered. End with Alex erasing the last diagram and leaving the board blank.

X_SCT_S1E07_S01_VIS.text: The body teaches the lesson before language does. Avoid an instant personality rewrite; this is a new capacity, not a cure.

X_SCT_S1E07_S02_VIS.text: Keep the scene deliberately small. Sour/sweet and wrong/right become contradictions they can live with rather than solve.

X_SCT_S1E08_S01_VIS.text: Do not turn the spoken section into a lecture detached from character. Intercut screens, sidewalks, apartments and generations. 'Watch, notice and wonder' becomes the new operative verb set.

X_SCT_S1E08_S02_VIS.text: The resolution is behavioral. Alex must not conduct or explain the meaning. Mira moves toward him only after the room has demonstrated that he can participate without controlling. Morning light lands on everyone.
